reference: Fun Run (S4E1, two-part season 4 premiere): Michael hits Meredith with his car in the office parking lot at the start of the episode; she gets a pelvic fracture, and Michael later holds a 'fun run' for rabies awareness (she tested positive for rabies at the hospital).

evidence.line: Michael: ...I feel very blessed. [slams on breaks, camera turns, Meredith rolls off the hood]
Michael: I was able to be on the scene so quickly because I was in the car that hit her.
Michael: A woman shouldn't have to be hit by a car, to learn that she may have rabies...

caveats: Combined numbering S4E1 = split S4E1-2 ('Fun Run' parts 1&2). The hit itself is shown visually (stage direction).
